whenToUse: Company or shopping sites with many sub-pages.
Sub-links can be grouped into columns by topic.
A short description for each link would help.
whenNotToUse: There are only a few sub-pages (a dropdown menu is enough).
You'd open it on hover alone (it opens by accident and gets in the way).

alternatives.name: Dropdown Menu
alternatives.reason: When there are only a few choices.

accessibility: Menu items are disclosure buttons with aria-expanded, without the ARIA menu role, so Tab moves through the links inside.
Esc closes it and returns focus to the item button.
